title: Tiny, cute key
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='gold' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#e6a800'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='goldLight' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#fff6b0'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ffd633'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- key bow (round head) -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='42' r='21' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='42' r='21' fill='none' stroke='#fff3a0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- cutout hole in bow -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='42' r='9' fill='#1b1033'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='42' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#fff3a0' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- shaft -->
  <rect x='48' y='37' width='40' height='10' rx='4' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <!-- shaft top highlight -->
  <rect x='50' y='38.5' width='36' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#fff6b0'/>

  <!-- teeth -->
  <rect x='76' y='45' width='7' height='15' rx='2' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <rect x='76' y='45' width='3' height='15' rx='1' fill='#fff6b0'/>
  <rect x='63' y='45' width='7' height='10' rx='2' fill='url(#gold)'/>
  <rect x='63' y='45' width='3' height='10' rx='1' fill='#fff6b0'/>

  <!-- tiny sparkle on bow -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='27' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='21' cy='56' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='57' r='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
</svg>
